objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (e.g. Level 2, Level 4).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation prefix with consecutive number (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented upon each new release.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Configurable period for validity checks (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable period for archival retention (default 10 years).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data, or IT applications.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The MS Office format in which the document content is authored.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document's release cycle.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment, following the main document's release statuses.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object linked to a document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished state of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal for changing an existing released document, managed independently of the document's version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and archive it, triggered when a document has no additional validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person in the system who can hold various roles and participate in document workflows.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: License role assigned to the user (e.g. Author, Reader, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign collective read or acknowledgement permissions on documents.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Type of user group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: An automated process instance that orchestrates the steps of release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement).

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current state of the workflow instance.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A recorded digital signature provided by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who signed.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature was applied.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step that was signed (e.g. Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A configured list of user groups and individual persons assigned to receive a document via email notification or for acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created by attaching a new information object with selection of a document type and optionally a template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the Creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and/or formal correctness as part of the release workflow.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Type of review performed (technical or formal).

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication, completing the release workflow.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_step
attributes.description: The workflow step at which rejection occurred (Review or Release).

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining all data from the previous version.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for new version (content change, attachment change, change proposal implementation, reactivation).

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the document's version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the document's version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of a change proposal, marking it as completed.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's valid-until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (or full release team) confirms that the document remains valid, updating the valid-until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: The override request is approved through the workflow, setting the document status to out of force.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: An invalidated document and its attachments have all authorizations revoked (except archive group) and enter the archive period.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the document is physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An archived document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata, authorizations, and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Upon release, users on the distribution list receive an email notification about the new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, users on the distribution list are requested by email to confirm acknowledgement of the document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a document via the workflow-supported acknowledgement task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read or write).

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A released document's content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated version of a document is checked and released through a workflow, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language of the released translation.
